Update on the cats 
Update 1)

We have tried with the trap for the one by our house since the post was made. It was caught 5 times (we've used this trap in the past without any problems) but it got out every time. Two days we didn't see it, but the day after it came again. Keeps coming back for food though and tomorrow we are going to borrow another trap and try with and see.

The orange we haven't seen again since. We don't always with him, but ofc we pray that he's okay and we will keep trying.

We have contact with a rescue if needed. But will most likely take them to our vet. When we get a hold of them and have taken them to the vet we might update again incase ppl would like to help towards treatment etc.

Until this, incase there's anyone that would like to help either our own rescues or the strays we feed, we have Wishlists on Amazon. I double-checked with admin and got an okay. Ofc it's not a must to help, it's completely voluntary.

Help asap

We just saw this girl come to us. She can't seem to be able to close her mouth, she's hurt. Skinny too. This is a first.

We also have an orange boy (very friendly, not neutered) that we see a couple of blocks away that has an abscess on the face (my son saw it last).

Both need to be trapped and taken care of. We do NOT have the possibility to take them in and foster. We have 11 cats ourselves (including a couple of ferals) and feed strays/rescue off the streets. 

Every time I've contacted rescues we get a no and I get it. But this is urgent and they need help. Can someone please help me get a rescue for them?! 

We are in desperate need of rescue, treatment etc with both of them! 

Located close to HomeDepot on Targee/Staten Island.
